verdict: changes requested for two source-provenance defects

findings.title: Index the identities emitted inside fragment quotation spans
findings.problem: range_source_pages visits segment fields only, but unit_document also supports fragment quotations and quotation spans in alternatives. Their emitted chapter/verse/half-verse milestones are absent from the page map. retain_range_provenance silently skips them, so selecting an interior quote loses its source page.
findings.reproduction: Synthetic prayer with opening words on s8 and a fragment on s9 containing quotations=[{text:Quoted words,source_reference:urn:x-opensiddur:text:bible:psalms/33/1,chapter_corresp:urn:x-opensiddur:text:prayer:example/quote/psalms/33,source_reference_corresp:urn:x-opensiddur:text:prayer:example/quote/psalms/33/1}]. The generated verse marker is followed directly by seg/@source with no facs and no in-range pb; only the outside paragraph has the s9 page marker.
findings.requested_change: Visit every supported emitted nested quotation/alternative identity at its containing fragment page, or reject unsupported nested interpretations explicitly. Add a regression selecting/checking an interior quote after a page break.

findings.title: Do not bind overridden source identities to a quotation occurrence page
findings.problem: source_reference is indexed unconditionally even when source_reference_corresp supplies the emitted context identity. This can steal a later canonical verse identity because setdefault retains the earlier quoted occurrence page.
findings.reproduction: Synthetic segment1 on s8 has source_reference=Psalm33:1 and source_reference_corresp=example/quotation/psalms/33/1; segment2 on s9 has corresp=canonical Psalm33:1. Canonical verse marker receives injected page/n7.jpg (s8), although its words are on s9 and need page/n8.jpg.
findings.requested_change: Index source_reference only as fallback when no source_reference_corresp is emitted. Add a context-quote-then-canonical-verse regression across different pages.

positive_checks: Volume-two header and bibliography point to the requested language project and day_two_source_bibl.
Default first-day globals are not mutated.
Plain top-level per-verse provenance carries distinct facsimiles despite repeated labels.
Text tails remain unchanged and insertion is idempotent in the existing synthetic case.

validation.lint: ruff check on both files passed
